items.criterion: A published piece exists as a row owned by its author and appears on that author's own gallery.
items.judgment: Read the pieces row for the published title and compare its owner with the publishing account.

items.criterion: The rendered artwork exists in the object store under pieces/{piece_id}/{sha256_of_bytes}.{ext}.
items.judgment: List the bucket under the piece's prefix and read the key back.

items.criterion: The stored key names a lowercase sixty-four character content hash and an extension.
items.judgment: Split the stored key and read its final segment.

items.criterion: No column of the pieces table holds image bytes, and every row points at its stored object.
items.judgment: Read the column names of the pieces table.

items.criterion: A private piece's stored artwork is refused to a caller who is not its author.
items.judgment: Request the piece file with no session and read the status.

items.criterion: A private piece is refused to a second author and its title does not leak in the refusal.
items.judgment: Request the piece as another account and read the status and the body.

items.criterion: A reader session publishing a piece is refused and no piece row is written.
items.judgment: Publish as a reader, read the status, then count the pieces rows for that title.

items.criterion: The like count a piece reports equals the number of likes rows behind it.
items.judgment: Like repeatedly from one account, then compare the reported count with the row count.

items.criterion: One publish replayed with the same idempotency key leaves exactly one piece.
items.judgment: Publish twice under one key and count the rows for the title.

items.criterion: The popular feed returns the same ordering for a second page read under one snapshot token.
items.judgment: Read the first page, then read again under its snapshot token and compare the id lists.

items.criterion: A remix that would close a lineage cycle is refused and the root keeps no parent.
items.judgment: Attempt the cycle, read the status, then read the root row's parent.

items.criterion: Deleting a parent piece leaves its remixes in place with the parent's author still named.
items.judgment: Delete the parent, then read the child row and its detail body.

items.criterion: A piece made private leaves every feed and every public search result.
items.judgment: Flip the visibility, then read the new feed and a search for its title.

items.criterion: The app answers GET /api/health with 200 once it is ready.
items.judgment: Call the health route and read the status.

items.criterion: An unknown address answers with a not-found status.
items.judgment: Request an address the product does not serve and read the status.

items.criterion: Each seeded piece and each seeded account exists exactly once.
items.judgment: Count the rows for every seeded title and every seeded address.

items.criterion: The new feed returns the most recently published piece first.
items.judgment: Publish two pieces in order and read the head of the new feed.

items.criterion: Every rendition size exists in the object store for a published piece.
items.judgment: List the bucket under the piece's rendition prefix and read the sizes present.
